description: Master index of all fashion rulebook and pipeline files.

pipeline_files.description: CLIP-based garment attribute extractor. Runs per-category CLIP inference, builds structured garment objects, flags low-confidence fields. Output feeds into training_pipeline.py.
pipeline_files.outputs: Structured garment object: { garment_type, color, fabric, pattern, fit, style, occasion, category, confidence_scores }

pipeline_files.description: Generates 543 synthetic labeled outfit examples, trains XGBoost regressor (score 0-100) and classifier (bad/medium/good), evaluates with cross-validation, saves models.
Runs training_pipeline.py + detectionV3.py together. Upload photos → CLIP extracts attributes → XGBoost scores outfit → saves result to wardrobe_db/. Links Req1 + Req4 of requirements.md.
Step-by-step instructions for running detectionV3.py in Google Colab.

files.description: Core menswear rules: color theory, fit, proportion, garment knowledge, outfit combinations, style systems (Ivy, Prep, Americana, Military, Workwear), timeless principles

Machine-readable lookup tables for the XGBoost scoring pipeline. Contains: color pairs, fabric compatibility, garment category balance, feature vector schema, occasion canonical labels, XGBoost training examples, footwear rules, pattern rules, season-material rules, fit combination rules, garment type taxonomy, scoring weights.
sources: Compiled from style conventions, color theory, and Rule Corpus

files.description: Streetwear principles: oversized fit, sneaker coordination, graphic balance, logo placement, layering systems, color palettes, proportions, statement pieces, hype vs timeless
Korean fashion principles: wide-fit silhouettes, cropped layering, tonal dressing, soft color palettes, modern minimalism, overshirt layering, Korean smart casual rules
Techwear principles: functional layering (base-mid-shell), technical fabrics, color system, silhouette rules, pocket design, weather-adaptive construction, modular systems
Luxury fashion principles: quiet luxury, fabric hierarchy, texture layering, neutral palette construction, sprezzatura, relaxed tailoring, luxury casualwear, investment piece logic
50 outfit formulas per category. Each formula includes: occasion, season, why it works. Categories: streetwear, korean_fashion, techwear, contemporary_luxury.
sources: Compiled from all style category sources

files.description: Rules for identifying style category from observable characteristics: silhouette, fabric, footwear, layering, color palette, accessories. Now includes classic_menswear signature. Decision tree extended to 10 steps covering all 5 categories.
sources: Compiled from all style category sources
